nodes.name: Webhook - Receive Claim
nodes.notes: Receives JSON with request_id, image_base64, user_description, order_id, product_name, and item_value.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ request_id: $('Webhook - Receive Claim').item.json.body.request_id, image_base64: $('Webhook - Receive Claim').item.json.body.image_base64, customer_description: $('Webhook - Receive Claim').item.json.body.user_description }) }}

nodes.name: Agent 1 - Vision Agent
nodes.notes: Analyzes the original product image and description.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ request_id: $('Webhook - Receive Claim').item.json.body.request_id, customer_description: $('Webhook - Receive Claim').item.json.body.user_description, vision_agent_json: $('Agent 1 - Vision Agent').item.json }) }}

nodes.name: Agent 2 - RAG Agent
nodes.notes: Retrieves policy passages using both the original description and Vision JSON.

nodes.name: Merge - Vision + RAG + Claim
nodes.notes: Passes the original claim, vision evidence, and retrieved policies to the decision agent.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ request_id: $json.request_id, order_id: $json.order_id, product_name: $json.product_name, item_value: $json.item_value, original_user_description: $json.original_user_description, vision_agent_json: $json.vision_agent_json, rag_agent_json: $json.rag_agent_json }) }}

nodes.name: Agent 3 - Decision Agent
nodes.notes: Runs self-consistency, business guardrails, and the local Ollama compliance judge before returning a decision.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', pipeline_trace: { vision_agent: $('Agent 1 - Vision Agent').item.json, rag_agent: $('Agent 2 - RAG Agent').item.json, decision_output: $('Agent 3 - Decision Agent').item.json } }) }}
